title: Bounded city piece clock v1 closed DTOs
description: Independent bounded single-city shared-xun and type-5 piece-reservation profile. Static schema document, not runtime validation evidence. Every data object is closed and requires all declared fields; complete fixed Policy and MerchantCatalog and full five instant / three piece kernel audits are retained. The engine separately rejects negative zero and unsafe object forms, and recomputes cross-field arithmetic, identity/order, markers, capacity, clock/horizon, bidirectional reservations, capture/trace/call relationships, null branches, rewards/writes, digests, receipts/history, legal coverage and actual UTF-8/node/depth budgets. Schema acceptance alone never proves reachability or authorizes effects. Synthetic fixtures contain inputs only; expected trace outcomes remain null.
